subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add official model/session reconcile-reset commands, and should they report only by default or also clear explicit session, agent, generated catalog, and auth pins under scoped flags?
rationale: The requested commands would inspect or mutate persisted model, provider, session, generated catalog, and auth-profile state, so source inspection cannot safely choose compatibility semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Report-first reconcile and scoped reset
options.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as dry-run/report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require narrow flags to clear them.

options.title: Diagnostics and doctor only
options.body: Keep runtime precedence unchanged and improve status, doctor, and validation warnings for shadowed or invalid model refs.

options.title: Automatic precedence change
options.body: Automatically clear or override existing pins when defaults change, accepting an intentional compatibility break for durable session or agent selections.

recommendation.title: Report-first reconcile and scoped reset
recommendation.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as dry-run/report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require narrow flags to clear them.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses model CLI, provider identity, status visibility, and compatibility policy surfaces where the strongest observed history signal is steipete.
